Our story

Cine De Riesgo was founded in 2020. Its first major milestone was Marco Polo, released nationwide in Spanish cinemas in 2023 for a month-long theatrical run. The film is now available on Amazon Prime Video.

The company also produced the science-fiction short films Mis-Alignment and Cuando Volvimos a la Tierra. Mis-Alignment premiered at AFI FEST, followed by a successful festival run that included the Hawaii International Film Festival and awards at the New Mexico International Film Festival and the Palm Springs International Film Festival. Cuando Volvimos a la Tierra premiered at the Academy Museum, screened at South by Southwest in 2024, and continued its successful festival run at the Dallas International Film Festival, among many others.

Cine De Riesgo has become a key player in the microdrama space, having shot more than 20 projects with ReelShort and built experience across more than 46 productions for other platforms.

The company is currently involved in the production of Me After You, a feature film directed by Ruben Navarro. It also recently worked on Agent of Shadows, the first collaboration between WWE and ReelShort. Shot in both vertical and horizontal formats, the film is awaiting its premiere.

Cine De Riesgo is also in pre-production on three further feature films: Uncanny Valley, Bloom, and Stasis.

Founder’s Story

Pablo Riesgo
Almonacid

Born in Spain, Pablo moved countries every three to four years from age 12 — a nomadic upbringing that led him to Los Angeles and an MFA in Directing from AFI.

His debut feature Marco Polo opened in Spanish theaters and streams on Amazon Prime and Filmin. Cuando Volvimos a la Tierra won the Spotlight Dorado grant, premiered at the Academy Museum and played SXSW 2024. His AFI thesis Mis-Alignment premiered at AFI FEST and won multiple Best Short awards.

Today he directs vertical series for ReelShort — including WWE and Crocs collaborations — while developing features across Spain, the US and Mexico through Cine de Riesgo.
